statusHistory.note: Baixada Santista content push (near-war-room), acting on BACKLOG.md's São Vicente leads paragraph -- Amuse Club, flagged there as needing verification before drafting, not assumed from the backlog note alone. Operator-directed research pass (chat request) -> trust: auto per rules.md trust-gate. Verified current via its own Instagram (@amuseclub), which shows live September 2026 programming -- a 5th-anniversary party on Sept 5, recurring 'Baile da AMUSE' nights, and cross-promoted dates with House of Mamba Negra (a ballroom/voguing collective) and Festa Pandora -- plus a live Facebook page and third-party QLIST listing, all corroborating the Al. Paulo Gonçalves, 680, Ilha Porchat address and sea-view rooftop/indoor-outdoor dance floor setup. No boat-party programming was found this pass despite the backlog note flagging it as a possibility -- not included in the copy since it can't be substantiated. The House of Mamba Negra connection is real and current per the venue's own Instagram, but a standalone Near piece on São Vicente's ballroom scene was not written this pass since House of Mamba Negra's own base/schedule could not be independently verified beyond this cross-promotion -- logged to content/requests.md instead of forced. Coordinates approximate for the Ilha Porchat address, not an independently verified geocode pin -- confidence 0.6. Hero image is the public Ilha Porchat overlook (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0) the venue itself sits on top of, not a venue-interior photo -- logged as a compromise pending a real photo.

geocode.query: Al. Paulo Gonçalves, 680, Ilha Porchat, São Vicente, SP — approximate placement from published venue address, not independently pin-verified
